title: Color Ball Drop: Rope Puzzle
shortPitch: Swipe gold ropes and wooden supports to release colored balls, trigger chain reactions across clever contraptions, and guide every ball into its matching bucket.
longDescription: Color Ball Drop: Rope Puzzle is an offline 2D physics puzzle game for Android built around timing, gravity, and clean chain reactions.

Across 100 handcrafted portrait levels and 5 chapters, you swipe through gold ropes and wooden beams, bounce across bumper pins, tip seesaw bridges, pass through color filter gates and dye rings, and guide red, blue, yellow, green, and heavy steel balls into matching buckets.
releaseNote: In development for Android. Coming soon to Google Play.

features.title: 100 Handcrafted Levels
features.description: Play across 5 chapters with 1 to 3 stars per puzzle and earn coins as each level scales up.

features.title: 12 Physics Contraptions
features.description: Combine gold ropes, wooden beams, steel chains, bumper pins, seesaw bridges, color gates, dye rings, and portals.

features.title: Daily Challenges & Hints
features.description: Take on daily puzzle runs, build streak rewards, and reveal step hints whenever a puzzle stumps you.

features.title: 8 Unlockable Blade Trails
features.description: Customize your swipe arc with eight blade trails unlocked using earned coins or star milestones.

features.title: Colorblind Symbols & Languages
features.description: Distinct geometric shapes on every colored ball and bucket, multiple languages, and sound and vibration toggles.

features.title: Built for Offline Portrait Play
features.description: One-hand Android touch controls with local device saves so every level stays playable offline.

privacy.summary: Pre-release privacy policy reflecting the current Android build of Color Ball Drop: Rope Puzzle. Advertising is disabled, in-app billing is not connected, optional analytics is turned off with no active server endpoint, and progress saves locally on your device.
privacy.adsStatus: Disabled in the current Android build. AdMob and UMP libraries are excluded from current builds. If advertising is enabled in a future release, this policy and our Google Play Data Safety disclosures will be updated before publishing.
privacy.billingStatus: Not connected in the current build. No live in-app purchases are processed.
privacy.analyticsStatus: Optional in-game analytics starts off by default and currently has no active server endpoint, so no telemetry is transmitted. If an optional analytics provider is enabled in a future update, players must opt in and may disable it anytime in Settings.
privacy.localSavesNote: Campaign progress, star counts, unlocked blade trails, and preferences are stored locally on your device. No user account, login, email, contacts, GPS, camera, or microphone access is requested.
